metadata_note: Metadata columns identify sessions and carry labels. They are never model inputs.
neutralization: common.simulation.neutralize(): removes '[LAB-SIMULATION]' and replaces the canary token in every message body before any feature is computed; sizes are recomputed from the neutralized JSON. Raw logs are not modified.
